from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
im=np.asarray(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB')).astype(np.int16)
r,g,b=im.transpose(2,0,1)
mx=im.max(2); mn=im.min(2); sat=mx-mn
# categories
for name,mask in [
 ('orange',(r>g+30)&(g>b+20)&(r>90)),
 ('blue',(b>r+15)&(b>g+5)&(b>40)),
 ('white',(mx>170)&(sat<35)),
 ('black',(mx<60)),
 ('brown',(r>g+12)&(g>b+8)&(r<210)),
 ('green',(g>r+12)&(g>b+8)),
 ('yellow',(r>g-10)&(g>b+30)&(r>100)),
]:
 ys,xs=np.where(mask)
 print(name, len(xs), ('bbox',xs.min(),ys.min(),xs.max(),ys.max()) if len(xs) else '')
# sample color at grid / point
print('sat percentiles',np.percentile(sat,[90,95,99,99.5,99.9,99.99]))
# max saturation coordinates
idx=np.argpartition(sat.ravel(),-30)[-30:]
ys,xs=np.unravel_index(idx,sat.shape)
for y,x in zip(ys,xs): print(x,y,im[y,x].tolist(), 'sat',sat[y,x])
